§6BSCCO§f

§aBismuth Strontium Calcium Copper Oxide. Sounds like a chemistry exam. It is your particle accelerator bottleneck.§f

§bBSCCO§f is a superconducting alloy made into dense wire. Without it, you cannot build the §bLarge BSCCO Coils§f needed for high-tier particle accelerator recipes.

§6Make It§f (Crucible):
§b•§f 2 Bismuth + 2 Strontium + 2 Calcium + 3 Copper (all nuggets)
§b•§f Output: §e1 BSCCO Ingot§f

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bLarge BSCCO Coil§f, 64 Dense BSCCO Wire + 64 Polymer Bars in assembly machine. Score range §e7,500-15,000§f
§b•§f §bSolid State Quantum Processor§f, for quantum computers and QPUs
§b•§f §bPlasma Forge§f, 32 Dense BSCCO Wire in the recipe
§b•§f Heavy Magnetic Storage Tank, Quantum Battery, Gerald the Android

§ePS:§f BSCCO gates the particle accelerator. No coils, no antimatter, no dark matter, no endgame. Automate bismuth, strontium, and calcium production before you need thousands of wire.
